uc1.title: Use case 1 — Temporal dynamics
uc1.alt: Use case 1 — Temporal dynamics: annual growth of light
uc1.caption: Between 2014 and 2025, night-time light in Mauritius changed by +6.6% per year (95% CI: +4.7% to +7.9%). Over the last 12 months, the seasonally adjusted level is -6.6% relative to the previous 12 months. (confidence high: significant trend (p < 0.01; n = 12))
uc1.source: VIIRS DNB monthly (VCMSLCFG) · NOAA/EOG · Google Earth Engine

uc3.title: Use case 3 — Lights and GDP
uc3.alt: Use case 3 — Lights and GDP: light–GDP elasticity
uc3.caption: The elasticity of light with respect to real GDP is 2.21 in levels (95% CI: 1.24 to 3.18, R² = 0.63, 12 years) and 0.34 in growth rates (CI: 0.01 to 0.66). Out of sample, light growth tracks GDP growth with a correlation of −0.16 (mean absolute error: 4.0 percentage points of growth). (confidence medium: n = 12, significant but wide CI (1.94))

uc4.title: Use case 4 — Economic shocks
uc4.alt: Use case 4 — Economic shocks: shock trough
uc4.caption: The most pronounced shock in the seasonally adjusted series is “COVID-19”: trough of -1.7% (04/2020), return to the pre-shock level after 3 months. (confidence low: trough compared with pre-shock month-to-month variability)
uc4.source: VIIRS DNB monthly (VCMSLCFG) · NOAA/EOG · Google Earth Engine

uc6.title: Use case 6 — Industrial zones
uc6.alt: Use case 6 — Industrial zones: industrial clusters
uc6.caption: 16 industrial clusters detected from concordant satellite signals: 4 heavy industry, 2 business parks & logistics, 5 oil & gas sites and 5 isolated sites to verify. They emit 17.1% of national light (latest year); their light changes by +2.6% per year. Plaines Wilhems has the most industrial activity. (confidence low: no reference list available to validate the detection)

uc7.title: Use case 7 — Summer tourism
uc7.alt: Use case 7 — Summer tourism: tourist zones
uc7.caption: No unit shows a significant net summer excess: no tourist season visible from space. (confidence low: no hotel-night statistics to validate the indicator)
uc7.source: VIIRS DNB monthly (VCMSLCFG) · NOAA/EOG · Google Earth Engine
